description: Retrieval check for the second question of a conversation. `follow_up` cases refer back to the previous question ('explain that again', 'what are its limits?'), so the right chunks are about the PREVIOUS question's topic. `topic_change` cases only look like they are in a conversation: the right chunks are about the NEW question's topic, and blending in the previous question must not hurt. A case counts as a hit if any of the top-3 chunks contains any of `topic_terms` (case-insensitive). This is a coarse proxy for 'the right chunk was found'; the gold-chunk metrics in qa_set.json are the stricter version.
